FROM gf_admin_message m JOIN (SELECT MAX(id) id FROM gf_admin_message GROUP BY user_id) latest ON latest.id = m.id LEFT JOIN gf_miniapp_user u ON u.id = m.user_id AND u.deleted = 0
AND (LOWER(u.nickname) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') ESCAPE '!' OR m.user_id = #{userId})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gf_admin_message unread WHERE unread.user_id = m.user_id AND unread.sender_type = 'USER' AND unread.is_read = 0)
